verdict.rationale: Datalab documents on-prem deployment: customers can run its models on infrastructure they control under an Enterprise contract, air-gapped per the pricing page, using a container with a Kubernetes Helm chart and a lightweight surya-us container type. The underlying Chandra, Marker and Surya models also remain free open source. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on corroboration of self-hosted deployments, no documentation that the full API stack (pipelines, structured extraction, segmentation) runs on-prem rather than just the models, and the managed self-hosting path is gated behind an Enterprise contract.
